Kurogo Kurusu, uno studente di quindici anni, ha una passione per il kabuki e spera di riuscire a fondare un club di kabuki presso la sua scuola. Ma le cose non sono facili come sembrano: la parte più difficile sarà  trovare qualche altro studente disposto a seguirlo...

episodes.title: I`m Here
episodes.synopsis: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

episodes.title: Let Me Race
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

episodes.title: View from the Top
episodes.synopsis: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

episodes.title: The Junior Crown
episodes.synopsis: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

episodes.title: What`s Best for Her
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

episodes.title: The Beast
episodes.synopsis: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

episodes.title: Tracen Academy
episodes.synopsis: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

episodes.title: The Right Stuff
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

episodes.title: The Japanese Derby
episodes.synopsis: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

episodes.title: The Peak
episodes.synopsis: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

episodes.title: The Star of Kasamatsu
episodes.synopsis: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

episodes.title: The Fall Tenno Sho
episodes.synopsis: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

episodes.title: Japan`s Best
episodes.synopsis: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters the last of their strength. With Oguri Cap right on her tail, Tamamo Cross begins to feel the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks past her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

info.title: Modest Heroes: Ponoc Short Films Theatre, Volume 1 (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lo Studio Ponoc, studio d'animazione giapponese fondato nel 2015 dagli ex di Studio Ghibli Hiromasa Yonebayashi (regista di Arrietty - Il mondo segreto sotto il pavimento, Quando c'era Marnie e Mary and the Witch's Flower) e Yoshiaki Nishimura (produttore de Il castello errante di Howl, La storia della principessa splendende e Quando c'era Marnie) realizza il progetto di un'antologia di corti. Si tratta del Ponoc Short Films Theater (Ponoc Tanpen Gekijo), che si compone di due "Volumi" dalle diverse tematiche. Il primo volume è Modest Heroes (Chiisana Eiyuu: Kani to Tamago to Toumei Ningen), che si compone a sua volta di tre diversi brevi episodi di circa 15 minuti diretti ognuno da tre diversi registi: Kanini & Kanino ("Kani no Kanino") da Hiromasa Yonebayashi, un fantasy con protagonisti due fratelli "granchi"; Life Ain't Gonna Lose ("Samurai Egg") da Yoshiyuki Momose, una commovente storia d'amore materno; Invisible ("Toumei Ningen") da Akihiko Yamashita, uno "spettacolare" action incentrato sulla lotta solitaria un uomo invisibile.

info.title: Devil May Cry (2025) (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Nuova serie basata sul videogioco omonimo.
La vicenda racconta le avventure di Dante, un mezzo demone che, nonostante la sua natura, lavora come cacciatore di demoni e gestisce l'agenzia tuttofare "Devil May Cry". Sebbene all'apparenza possa sembrare pigro e scontroso, Dante non si tira mai indietro quando si tratta di aiutare chi è in difficoltà ed è sempre pronto a maneggiare con magistrale bravura la sua potente spada e le sue inseparabili pistole.

info.title: I cinque samurai: Message
info.synopsis: Diverso tempo dopo l'ultima battaglia combattuta dai cinque samurai, questi si riuniscono a seguito del rinvenimento di un antico manoscritto, secondo il quale gli avvenimenti accaduti fino a quel momento che li hanno coinvolti sarebbero già stati previsti in quanto già scritti dal destino. Questa scoperta fa cadere i cinque guerrieri nel dubbio e nell'angoscia: che senso avrebbero avuto i loro sforzi e le loro sofferenze se era già tutto deciso a priori?

info.title: Spring and Chaos
info.synopsis: Mediometraggio ispirato alla vita del letterato Kenji Miyazawa, film molto stilizzato che prende spunto dalle tecniche di scrittura di Miyazawa per raccontarne la storia. Miyazawa ha usato spesso degli animali come personaggi nelle sue storie e poesie, con questo espediente il regista Shoji Kawamori ricrea la terra di Ihatov e la utilizza come sfondo per il racconto biografico.

info.title: Captivated, By You
info.synopsis: La storia si forma attraverso i racconti paralleli e incrociati di alcuni giovani liceali: Hayashi Miyoshi non è colui che si definirebbe il classico normale studente poiché non disdegna ingenue eccentricità. Il ragazzo ama affrontare la vita seguendo il proprio ritmo e rimanendo impassibilmente fedele a se stesso, nonostante ciò che gli altri potrebbero pensare di lui. Proprio tale franchezza, in verità, fa sì che Miyoshi abbia la capacità di attirare discretamente l'attenzione delle persone, anche senza volerlo. Mentre lui abbraccia il lato più leggero della vita e attira gli altri verso quella luce, il liceale Akira Nikaido fa esattamente il contrario: il ragazzo ha lavorato duramente per costruirsi una maschera oscura, attraverso cui tenere gli altri lontani. Nikaido trasuda tristezza e malinconia e chiunque considera la sua presenza un cattivo presagio, tranne il compagno di classe Medaka: dopo aver scorto il ragazzo dietro la maschera, Medaka è determinato a scalfirla per far uscire il compagno dal guscio e riportarlo alla luce.

info.title: Metropolis
info.synopsis: L'investigatore privato Shunsaku Ban si reca nella città-stato di Metropolis con il nipote Kenichi, per indagare su un presunto traffico di organi umani, in cui sembra essere implicato un misterioso scienziato, il dottor Laughton. Le indagini portano a scoprire che questo losco individuo ha dei rapporti di affari con il presidente di Metropolis, il Duca Red, il quale ha istituito una società in cui i robot vivono in una condizione di schiavitù nei confronti degli esseri umani.

Sulle tracce del volatile, però, vi sono Freezer e Frozen, due demoni del ghiaccio che intendono eliminarlo e mutare il mondo in un inferno di ghiaccio eterno.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: On his way to visit the Queen of the Garden of Light, the Sage of the Garden of Clouds accidentally drops the egg of the Houhou. The egg lands in the Garden of Rainbows, where it is found by Hikari, attracting the attention of a powerful pair of servants of the Dark Lord.

info.title: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
info.synopsis: Akira è uno studente delle superiori che si sottopone al sonno criogenico e si risveglia 200 anni dopo in un mondo devastato dalla guerra. Ora una nuova organizzazione unificata nota come OWEL governa l'intera umanita, ed un nuovo sistema chiamato "Elsie" ha sostituito il matrimonio. Ma la prima cosa che vede Akira al suo risveglio è Yugure, un'androide che assomiglia in modo impressionante alla sua ragazza Towasa. In quel momento riceve una richiesta che lo lascia confuso e disorientato: una repentina proposta di matrimonio dell'androide. Nonostante questo Akira è convinto che la sua ragazza possa ancora esistere in qualche forma anche in questo mondo, quindi decide di partire per un viaggio alla ricerca della sua amata affiancato da Yugure.

episodes.title: The Woman Who Sailed the Soul
episodes.synopsis: Akira is a stranger in a strange land. As the locals decide his fate, he must learn what happened to Towasa and the world that left him behind.

episodes.title: In the North After Doomsday
episodes.synopsis: Akira needs answers. But between an android insisting on marriage and an aspiring storybook artist, his search for the past may lead him somewhere entirely unexpected instead.

episodes.title: Dancing with You Under the Rainy Summer Sky
episodes.synopsis: Despite Yugure's protests, Akira can't leave Amoru in the hands of OWEL. But a high-stakes rescue is the least of their troubles.

episodes.title: A Game of Lime and Allegiance
episodes.synopsis: Akira and Yugure are drawn into a double date as well as family baggage.

episodes.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Doves?
episodes.synopsis: Akira learns more about the AI War.

episodes.title: The Machine That Shouted Love at the End of the World
episodes.synopsis: Love is a complicated emotion. As Akira and Yugure go on a date, Amoru must wrestle with her jealousy.

episodes.title: Paper Songs of a Budding Primate
episodes.synopsis: Amoru's desperate search for her parent's banned storybooks leads her and Akira to a secured library.

episodes.title: To the Ocean Horizon Descends a Treacherous Swallow
episodes.synopsis: Akira's group hide from OWEL after escaping the library.

episodes.title: Overlooking the Expanse of Days Past
episodes.synopsis: They say true love conquers all, but sometimes, even love isn't enough. Especially when secrets and lies threaten to tear people apart.

episodes.title: His and Her Long Afternoon
episodes.synopsis: A single act of violence shattered Akira and Towasa's lives in the distant past, yet time marches on. What happened after that fateful day of the shooting?

episodes.title: "Don`t Cry," She Said
episodes.synopsis: Amaru wants to be with Akira and Yugure, but circumstances make that an impossibility. But what if there was a way to make her wish come true?

episodes.title: Your Love Belongs to You
episodes.synopsis: Love is as messy as it is transformative. It can drive people to selfish extremes just as much as it can drive them to heroic sacrifice. In the end, what does love mean to Akira and Yugure?

info.title: Time Bokan 24
info.synopsis: Remake della prima serie di Time Bokan risalente al 1975. In questo nuovo anime invece siamo nel 24° secolo e il protagonista è Tokio, uno studente delle medie repentinamente assunto nell'amministrazione Spazio-Tempo. Si è scoperto che improvvisamente i libri e gli annali riportano eventi storici molto diversi rispetto a quelli universalmente noti, e Tokio parte così con la partner Calen sulla 24 Bokan Mecha per ripristinare il corso della storia. I due se la dovranno vedere con la banda della History Paradise, un editore che vuole mantenere la storia com'è per vendere libri.

episodes.title: Cleopatra Was Actually a Comedy Duo Known as Cleo and Patra!
episodes.synopsis: Time traveler Calen is hopping through time, trying to get away from Akudarma Trio. After a direct hit, she is forced to crash land in 2016 and encounters a boy named Tokio. The Akudarma Trio is right behind, so she has no choice but to take Tokio with her to the 24th century to escape. There, Tokio finds out that Calen works for the JKK, an organization that travels through time, trying to find out the True History. Tokio then finds himself travelling with Calen to Ancient Egypt to find out the truth about Cleopatra.

episodes.title: The Wright Brothers Were Actually an Only Child!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen travel to North Carolina in 1903 in order to find the True History behind the Wright Brothers. The Wright Brothers they met there were not making planes, let alone bicycles, but were apparently brothers that just happened to make "lights" for bicycles. However, there seemed to be something wrong with the younger brother, Orville... actually, uh, he's a doll?! Akudarma wants to keep the history as it is in the textbooks, and tries to get Wright to fly a plane. It appears that Tsubuyakky has a plan, but...

episodes.title: Momotaro Was Actually More of an Ogre Than an Actual Ogre!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen go to Onigashima to find the next True History. And then a peach came rolling down the river... wait, that's a red ogre's butt?! The red ogre tells them that he was punished by someone more ogre-like than actual ogres and starts crying. He leads them to a stage, where loud music is playing, and the one on stage who has all the female ogres' attention is a super hot Momotaro?! Calen tries to go talk some sense into him, but falls for him, too! Wait, Bimajo, too?!

episodes.title: Dinosaurs Were Humans` Pets!
episodes.synopsis: This time, they travel to the Mesozoic Era. They arrive to a jungle in the Mesozoic Era and find a True History signal. Right when they get there, a dinosaur pops out! However, it has a ribbon on and they find out that dinosaurs are pets. Tokio mentions that he wants a T-Rex for a pet but then Mechabuton gets taken. At this rate, they won't be able to return to their own time...

episodes.title: Halloween`s Trick or Treat Was Actually Tottori or Shimane!
episodes.synopsis: This time, it's the True History about Halloween. However, the place they arrive is the Tottori Desert in the 4th year of the Meiji Era. Tokio and Calen meet the host, Fukuzawa-san, who they think they've seen before. Apparently people mistake Tottori and Shimane quite often, so he holds a quiz about them. It starts on October 31st... Wait, does that mean "trick or treat" was originally "Tottori or Shimane"? Akudarma won't allow for such a punny history, so they also participate in the quiz...

episodes.title: Shibuya`s Hachiko Was Actually a Bee!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Shibuya Station in the 8th year of Showa to find the True History about Hachiko. They immediately find a dog waiting outside the station. They figure it must be Hachiko and go over to him, but instead, they find... Just then, they get a True History signal, but can't seem to find Hachiko. But they look closer the dog's nose, and they see a bee... Wait, is the bee Hachiko?! Of course, Akudarma shows up once again to get in their way of the True History.

episodes.title: What Columbus Discovered Was Not a New Continent, but a New Exercise Called Gymnastics!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen go back to Spain in 1492 to find the true history about Columbus and his journey to find the new continent. However, when they find him, they realize he has no interest in a new continent, but is trying to discover the next new exercise...

episodes.title: Seton Animal Chronicles Was Actually Donut Chronicles!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to New York in the late 1800's to discover the True History about Seton's Animal Chronicles. When they arrive, they find out that Seton isn't trying to chronicle animals, but donuts instead...

episodes.title: Gagarin`s Famous Quote Was, "The Earth Is ______"!
episodes.synopsis: In order to find out the True History about Gagarin, who was famous for saying that the Earth was blue, Tokio and Calen head back to the Soviet Union in 1961. They find some astronaut trainees and immediately find that Akudarma is already there. Gagarin comes in between them, saying that it's not right to fight underneath the blue sky, but he seems extremely interested in Tokio. Apparently, he really likes the color blue, but... This time, they can't seem to find a True History signal very easily, so the head to Space with Gagarin. Just what is the True History this time?

episodes.title: The Land-taking Battle During the Warring States Era Was Actually a _____ Battle!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen travel back to 1560 into the Sengoku Era in order to find the True History about Oda Nobunaga. When they get to Kiyosu Castle, there were giant rhinoceros beetles decorating the roof! The guards at the gate even had dung beetle helmets and were holding bug nets rather than swords. Nobunaga says that the one who rules over bugs will rule over Japan and was having a bug-catching battle. Akudarama presents Nobunaga with a fake rhinoceros beetle, so they can move quickly up the ranks and control Nobunaga...

episodes.title: Guns First Being Introduced to Japan Was Actually ______ First Being Introduced to Japan!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Tanegashima in 1543 to when guns first arrived to Japan. What the Europeans actually brought were... actually underwear?! However, Akudarma actually steals the underwear and at this rate, they won't be able to witness the True History. And so instead, they use... Tokio's underwear?! His underwear ends up becoming a hit throughout the town. Despite it being their mission, Calen couldn't help but feel conflicted about it. Apparently there was something strange about the lord of Tanegashima, as well...

episodes.title: Joan of Arc Was the First ______!
episodes.synopsis: In search of the True History about Jeanne D'arc, Tokio and Calen arrive to Orléans, France. The encounter a thief as soon as they get there, but then a magical girl shows up. Huh? And she's Jeanne D'arc? You'd think she'd use magic but instead she just hits the thief with her wand. Apparently she's acting like a magical girl because of her boyfriend. Meanwhile, Akudarma shows up disguised as angels from Heaven and try to give Jeanne a sword, but...

episodes.title: Santa Claus Was Actually ______!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Greenland in 2016 and meet a very musculuar old man with a white beard and and red suit named Rudolph and his reindeer. For a moment, they thought that the True History that Santa was a macho guy, but then starts pulling the sleigh himself. However, Rudolph ends up passing out from a fever. Tokio and Calen take over delivering presents for him. Apparently Bimajo has some unfinished business with Santa and was waiting for this chance, but...

episodes.title: The Ninja Hattori Hanzo Was Actually a ______!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Suruga Province in 1585. There, they find Hattori Hanzo showing off something like ninjutsu called Hanzo Power. However, Akudarma is trying to get him to become a ninja like in the history books by revealing the secrets to all of his magic tricks. This greatly depresses Hanzo because it'll be hard to regain his audience that he lost. Tokio then suggests that he try to make a castle on top of a mountain disappear...

episodes.title: Pythagoras Was Actually a Genius of ______!
episodes.synopsis: Calen and Tokio travel back to Ancient Greece to find out the True History about Pythagoras. When they get there, they find rather than finding a mathmatician, they find an old man who's amazing at making trick mechanisms...

episodes.title: Galileo Galilei Was Actually a ______!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Italy in 1589. They find some slightly chubby people pushing the Leaning Tower of Pisa diagonally. Apparently it always ends up straight when no one’s pushing on it. And then, Galileo Galilei shows up swaying to some music and starts rapping. Apparently Galileo was a rapper! Akudarma attempt to do a rap battle with him to try to get him to study astronomy...

episodes.title: What Sanzo Hoshi Was Striving for Was the World`s Best ______!
episodes.synopsis: Calen and Tokio travel back to Ancient China to find out the True History about Sanzo Hoshi. When they get there, they find out that Sanzo Hoshi is actually a comedy producer and Son Goku and the others are comedians. Right when they get there, they seem to be having a dispute...

episodes.title: The Nazca Lines Were __________!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Peru when the Nasca Lines were being drawn. There, they meet a young man named Nasca, who is drawing on the ground. He apparently wants to tell someone how he really feels, and that's why he's drawing on the ground, but the drawings look awful. As usual, Akudarma arrives and tries to get in the way with an artist mecha. However Nasca isn't even upset... Rather he's moved by how great the drawings are and asks Akudarma to let him be their apprentice and jumps into their cockpit...

episodes.title: Murasaki Shikibu Was Actually a ________!
episodes.synopsis: Calen and Tokio travel back to Kyoto in 1008 to find out the True History about Murasaki Shikibu. They immediately try to find her, but instead, they find a club where all the women there are dressed in purple. They also seem rather startled at the fact that Calen is wearing pink. Apparently Murasaki Shikibu was the name of a club where the members loved purple more than anything else. Bimajo tries to become the president of the club and tries to squash the club as well as the True History...

episodes.title: The Shinsengumi Was Actually a _________ Group!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen travel back to the Bakumatsu Era of Japan to find out the True History about the Shinsengumi. When they get there, rather than seeing a group of brave samurai ready to cut down those who oppose the shogunate, they find a bunch of guys wearing masks, running away from girls. Apparently the Shinsengumi was a group of hot guys who were too deathly shy to show their faces in public.

episodes.title: Versailles Was Actually a ________ Center!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Versailles in France in the 18th century. However, when they get there, they see a sign for “Fashion Center Versailles.” When they went in, they find a young woman in casual clothes welcoming in housewives. However, the housewives get angry and go home without buying anything. Huh? Apparently that girl is Marie Antoinette?! Akudarma steps in and tries to lead tries to lead Marie into the lifestyle of extravagance, but...

episodes.title: America`s Moon Landing Was Staged!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive in America in 1969 to find out the True History about the Moon landing. However, they arrive in Hollywood and sneak into a studio... There, they find a set that looks like the Moon landing. Apparently they were preparing to deal with filming since President Nixon suddenly said they would go to the Moon on July 20th. Meanwhile, Akudarma tries to figure out what to do since they find out the Moon landing was fake. Bimajo says that they should just go to the Moon themselves, but...

episodes.title: Nightingale Was Actually the ________ in White!
episodes.synopsis: Tokio and Calen arrive to Tuscany in 1820 and meet Nightingale, who had just been born. They then continue to Time Bokan looking for the True History as she grows up, but Nightingale continues to grow more and more high-handed. She then makes a white nurse’s uniform and starts posing in it. Bimajo makes the comment that rather than an angel in white, she seems like a tengu in white. It’s then that Calen’s visor gets a signal... Wait, that’s the True History this time?!

episodes.title: The Genius da Vinci Was the Final Episode!
episodes.synopsis: Akudarma arrive to the Republic of Florence in the 16th century, and meet da Vinci, who welcomes them with open arms. However, upon closer inspection, they see that there are even more hands and feet behind him... There are 24 people behind him! Tokio and Calen are also surprised, but they are suddenly thrown into a mecha battle. They go in with Bokan Dragon, but Akudarma powers up with a secret weapon and they get blown away. They quickly Time Bokan and manage to get away, but apparently da Vinci followed them to the 24th century?!

info.title: Spicchi di cielo tra baffi di fumo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Tratto dal romanzo I fratelli neri dei coniugi Kurt Held e Lisa Tetzner, pubblicato nel 1941. Romeo no aoi sora ci mostra uno spaccato vivo e crudo della compravendita di minori effettuata nel nostro paese alla fine dell’ottocento. Romeo, un ragazzino che vive sulle Alpi della Svizzera italiana, firma, per pagare il medico al padre malato, un contratto con un losco individuo, che lo condurrà attraverso i monti fino in Italia, a Milano, dove sarà venduto come aiutante di uno spazzacamino. Inizia così il viaggio di Romeo, tra soprusi e violenze.

episodes.title: In the Alps; a Village in Crisis
episodes.synopsis: Romeo is a boy who lives in a drought-afflicted village in the Swiss Alps, where Mr. Luini, known as the God of Death, looks to purchase him.

episodes.title: Destiny`s Beginnings: the Family Within the Flames
The Ship Sinks; Friendship Within the Storm
A Love Letter in the Moonlight
To Vanish into the City of Mists

Sing our Song of Unity on into the Dawn!
The Start of a Long Day

info.title: Eren the Southpaw
info.synopsis: Asakura Koichi lavora come designer per un'agenzia pubblicitaria. Anche se si impegna molto per soddisfare la sua compagnia, non riceve mai alcun riconoscimento per il suo lavoro. Questo fa sentire Koichi costantemente frustrato. Un giorno, decide di visitare un luogo che gli ricorda i tempi della sua infanzia con Yamagishi Eren. Nell'intanto, Yamagishi Eren è diventata una pittrice ben nota a New York con il soprannome "La Mancina" (“Hidarikiki”). Eren è dotata di un talento naturale per la pittura, ma per via del suo genio, si ritrova ultimamente a passare dei momenti di sofferenza.

episodes.title: The Basquiat of Yokohama
episodes.synopsis: Koichi Asakura, a graphic designer, recalls his brutal past encounter with Eren Yamagishi back in high school.

episodes.title: There`s Something Beyond This, Y`Know
episodes.synopsis: Eren struggles with her past as she watches Koichi try to improve his skills by attending an art studio.

episodes.title: All I`ve Got is Guts, After All
episodes.synopsis: Koichi's world comes crashing down when he's hit with the harsh reality of working at an ad agency.

episodes.title: When You Find Yourself The Best Team
episodes.synopsis: Welcome to Teamwork 101. Dive into Kamiya's past, how Team Kamiya was formed, and the trouble that lies ahead.

episodes.title: The Life of the One Who Shines the Light
episodes.synopsis: The Team is given 10 days to come up with a CM that satisfies Co. P. Koichi tries to consult Sales, however...

episodes.title: The Two on Opposite Shores
episodes.synopsis: Akari Kishi, a model and art student, takes interest in Eren after hearing about her. Eren is unfazed until...

episodes.title: Don`t Give That Person Happiness
episodes.synopsis: Sayuri's sudden visit takes Eren by surprise. But what Sayuri is about to tell her will change everything.

episodes.title: Don`t You Dare Take This Job Lightly
episodes.synopsis: A month since Kamiya's leave, Koichi struggles under Yanagi, as his words push Koichi to his limits until...

episodes.title: I Will Emit a Light and Disappear
episodes.synopsis: Akari reflects on her past as she prepares to face Natalie Russo, a model, who has come to challenge her.

episodes.title: My Life Never Started After All
episodes.synopsis: A rebranding project comes to Rukawa as he decides to assign Koichi for the job. Will this shine a new light?

episodes.title: Eren the Southpaw.
episodes.synopsis: Amidst a slump, Sayuri consults an art dealer, Jack, when a certain call comes, demanding to see Eren.

episodes.title: The Perfect Me
episodes.synopsis: Looking for a new face for the cosmetic line, Koichi starts an audition process using non-talents. When...

episodes.title: To All the People Who Couldn`t Become Geniuses
episodes.synopsis: Koichi is still waiting for his life to begin and gives it his all at his latest job.

episodes.title: Home Cooking and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya and Chizuru have decided to make a movie together so that Granny Sayuri can see it. That's all well and good, but now they have to sit down and work out all the details.

episodes.title: Girlfriend Next Door
episodes.synopsis: Ruka demands an explanation from Kazuya and Chizuru, and Mini overhears it all going down! What will she do with this information?

episodes.title: Expert and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: With the momentum of the crowdfunding campaign stalling, Kazuya must turn to Mini, who happens to be an expert on the matter!

episodes.title: D-Day and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Mini's earnest appeal makes things awkward. Meanwhile, Umi makes a request in return for retweeting the campaign.

episodes.title: Filming and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Filming for the movie begins, and seeing her act in the flesh, Kazuya realizes that Chizuru exists in a whole different dimension from him. Meanwhile, Mini is hatching a plot of her own.

episodes.title: Final Scene and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya and Chizuru end up at a ski resort, finding themselves having to shoot the final scene for the movie all on their own. Chizuru decides she has something to say to Kazuya.

episodes.title: Kazuya and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: It's Ruka's birthday, and Kazuya has to stay true to his word and grant her anything she desires. But what does she want, really?

episodes.title: Family and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Sayuri tags along with Kazuya and Chizuru as they scout out the cinema they'll be screening their movie in, and it brings back memories for her.

episodes.title: Parting and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: With Sayuri's prospects looking bleak, Kazuya pulls off the only thing he can do for Chizuru and her.

episodes.title: Spontaneous Trip and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Not knowing what to do, Kazuya looks to good old Sumi for advice. She decides to take him on a trip to help clear his mind.

episodes.title: Girlfriend and Boyfriend
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya decides to rent Chizuru out for an entire day and puts together a date plan to help cheer her up. Will he be successful?

episodes.title: Ideal Girlfriend and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Seeing Chizuru overcome with grief, Kazuya decides to give her an outlet and sees the ensuing moment as a big change in their relationship.

info.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea
info.synopsis: Dopo aver concluso la cerimonia di apertura della "Federazione del Regno dei Demoni di Tempest", Rimuru e i suoi compagni sono invitati dall’Imperatrice Celeste Hermesia della grande nazione elfica a visitare la sua isola privata. Mentre il gruppo si gode la sua breve vacanza, appare una donna misteriosa di nome Yura e, improvvisamente, avviene uno strano incidente sullo sfondo del mare azzurro sconfinato...

info.title: Psyren
info.synopsis: Ageha Yoshina, uno studente delle superiori, trova una misteriosa scheda telefonica rossa con la scritta Psyren. Poco dopo, la sua compagna di classe Sakurako Amamiya, entrata in possesso di una scheda identica, scompare improvvisamente, lasciando dietro di sé solo un disperato messaggio di aiuto. Spinto dalla volontà di salvarla e di scoprire la verità, Ageha decide di usare la scheda. In questo modo viene trasportato in Psyren, un mondo ostile e pericoloso in cui la sopravvivenza è tutt'altro che garantita. Qui incontra altri partecipanti come lui e scopre di poter risvegliare poteri psichici, indispensabili per affrontare le minacce che lo circondano. Tra combattimenti, prove sempre più dure e misteri irrisolti, Ageha dovrà lottare per restare vivo e trovare un modo per riportare a casa Sakurako.

episodes.title: Urban Legend
episodes.synopsis: High school student Ageha finds a mysterious telephone card in a phone booth.

episodes.title: Tavoo
episodes.synopsis: The Psyren game begins. Ageha must protect Amamiya in a world overrun by monsters.

episodes.title: Psi
episodes.synopsis: Ageha and his friends have ended up in a death game. While heading for the finish line, before they can make it to safety, an unworldly monster calls a Taboo appears before them.

episodes.title: Recall
episodes.synopsis: In a bid for survival, Ageha undergoes PSI training. Meanwhile, the actor Oboro and opportunistic Kabuto also receive phone cards.
